notes.title: General Update 2.2.0 & Chinese Localization
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27030967/249d4d479b86cb4b675fa8b0c0a54548d87acca1.jpg[/img]
Dear chess masters,

We have revised the game according to your ratings and added a[b] Chinese localization[/b] for all chess fans in and from China. Please continue to share your suggestions and opinions about the game with us. We are happy about every review!

[b]The improvements in detail - Changelog 2.2.0:[/b]
- Randomized Animation
- Computer-figures now move on the board to their new position (instead of instant placing)
- Chinese localization added
- Minor Puzzle-Bugs fixed
- UI-Problems fixed
- Localization-Errors fixed

notes.title: Stranded Sails – Shovel & Spyglass replace Master Sword & Shield
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025590/087d82e7de9d06f29e86c3a1c3b9396948cae2d4.jpg[/img]

Unique mix of adventure gameplay in the vein of Legend of Zelda and Stardew Valley-esque farming simulation

https://store.steampowered.com/app/943260

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Unique mix of adventure and farming simulator:[/b] Prove yourself as a dauntless adventurer and crafty farmer!
[*] [b]Exploration, crafting and farming:[/b] You will need better and better equipment and enough food for your journeys deep into the heart of the islands!
[*] [b]Story-driven quests: [/b]Quests tell the game's story and lead you from one adventure to the next!
[*] [b]Tricky puzzles and challenges:[/b] Fire up those tiny grey cells to solve the many exciting riddles!
[*] [b]Creation and expansion of a survivors' camp: [/b]Manage your provisional camp to survive!
[*] [b]Mysterious islands and dangers:[/b] Solve the secret of the cursed islands and fight against supernatural threats! 
[/list]

Take a first peek at the game with our Pre Alpha-Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MObtP-h4-Qg&t=

notes.title: Say hello to update 2.0.2 - New UI, new difficulty and more puzzles!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27030967/6d7a1e258d3d36c1f4030182ebc798a49a7c3489.jpg[/img]


[h1]New improvements and features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Completely new UI
[*]85 new puzzles to solve
[*]2 new sets of Chess pieces, with one of it animated!
[*]2 new backgrounds
[*]New 3D top/down view
[*]Optimzed engine-performance
[*]New difficulty "Experienced"
[*]Improved "Hard" difficulty for a greater challenge
[*]Added Steam-Cloud savegames
[*]Sound for UI -Clicks
[*] Space-scene now with sound
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Background sounds can  now be correctly adjusted in the sound menu
[*]Pawn turncoating on last sqauare
[*]Illegal move occasionally allowed
[/list]

notes.title: 3D Chess v1.2 now available! New boards! New figures! Linux!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27030967/4cf7d30ababd668b84f18bf8b1ea774a15c58acd.jpg[/img]

Dear 3D-Chess players.
We are very happy to announce our first major update of 3D Chess! The following features have been added:
- New background "Space"
- New background "Fantasy Town"
- New chess pieces "Voxel-Fantasy"
- Linux-version
- 2D board rotated when playing black
- minor usability enhancements
- some smaller bugfixes
Hope you enjoy the new features, have fun,
Tassilo @ bumblebee. :ChesspieceQueen:
